examples.japanese: {退勤|たいきん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打刻|だこく}→打刻：noentry⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。

notes:
{退勤|たいきん} means leaving work for the day — the formal counterpart of casual expressions like ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧が⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ or ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧.

WORD FORMATION:
{退|たい} (withdraw, leave) + {勤|きん} (work, service)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退勤|たいきん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: clock-out time
- {退勤|たいきん}⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧: after leaving work
- {退勤|たいきん}する: to leave work, to clock out
- {退勤|たいきん}⟦{打刻|だこく}→打刻：noentry⟧: clocking out (punching the time card)

CONTRAST:
- {退勤|たいきん} (leaving work) ↔ ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ (going to work)
- ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧ can mean either leaving the office for the day OR leaving the company (quitting)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦タイムカード→タイムカード：28560_taimukaado⟧を⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to punch the time card
- {打刻|だこく}する: to clock in/out
- ⟦{定時|ていじ}→定時：07697_teiji⟧で⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to leave at the regular time
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧: overtime work

REGISTER:
Formal/workplace term. Used on time cards, attendance systems, and workplace communication.
